<tool_call>

<parameter=code>
def grid_state(fr):
    seg=fr.segmentation['nodes']
    d={}
    for nd in seg:
        bnd=nd['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in bnd); r1=max(p[0] for p in bnd)
        c0=min(p[1] for p in bnd); c1=max(p[1] for p in bnd)
        if 47<=r0<=63 and 22<=c0<=38 and nd['color'] in ('W','N','g','S','b'):
            # map to 3x3 cell
            row=(r0-48)//5; col=(c0-23)//5
            d.setdefault(nd['color'],[]).append((row,col))
    return {k:sorted(v) for k,v in d.items()}
print("before:",grid_state(current_frame))
# Probe 1: click plus box center
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':55,'col':15}])
print("after plus-box click:",grid_state(current_frame))
# Probe 2: click grid center cell
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':55,'col':30}])
print("after grid-center click:",grid_state(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
